subject: Showing a message for 3 seconds, then have it go away

messages.author: 39f5a1aeeec9eadd
messages.subject: Showing a message for 3 seconds, then have it go away
parts:
Hi all. I have a button called "Save" that executes some sql queries when clicked, and I would like to display a message (like, "Saved") to let the user know that the click to "Save" was successful.

This is the best I've figured so far, but seems wasteful as invalidateLater() triggers shiny to do something without the "Save" button being clicked.

# ui.r
...
actionButton('save', 'Save'),
htmlOutput('saved_promptHTML')
...

# server.r
...
values <- reactiveValues()
values[['show_saved_prompt']]

observe({
  if(input$save == 0) return()
  isolate({
    values[['show_saved_prompt']] <- TRUE
  })
})

output$saved_promptHTML <- renderText({
    if(!values[['show_saved_prompt']]) return()
    'Saved'
  })
  
  observe({
    invalidateLater(3000, session)
    isolate({
      values[['show_saved_prompt']] <- FALSE
    })
  })
...

This is not really optimal and was wondering if anyone has a more appropriate way to achieve this effect.

Thanks!

Dan
